profile.goodFor: tone shaping with up to 8 bands: cutting rumble and harshness, adding air or weight

settings.name: Band 1 frequency
settings.what: band 1's frequency; by default a low cut for rumble

settings.name: Band 2 gain
settings.what: low shelf boost or cut: weight

settings.name: Band 4 gain
settings.what: boost or cut around the low mids (mud, boxiness)

settings.name: Band 6 gain
settings.what: boost or cut around the upper mids (presence, harshness)

settings.name: Band 7 gain
settings.what: high shelf boost or cut: air and brightness

settings.name: Band 3 Q
settings.what: how narrow a band is (every band has one); higher is narrower
